items: 【Modern Style】This modern fuzzy dog couch cover features soft hues and delicate patterns that seamlessly blend with any home decor. It protects your furniture, floors, or sofa surfaces from scratches and stains.

【Cozy & Soft】Our sofa covers washable are handmade from high-density facecloth—thick, skin-friendly, and resistant to shedding, fading, and deformation (even with long use). This couch slipcover eases your fatigue.

【Non-Slip Design】The couch cushion covers come with built-in silicone particles that grip tightly to sofas or floors. This prevents shifting and keeps the cover stable—even when your pet is playing, jumping, or moving around actively.

【Easy to Clean】Machine washable! These couch blankets use a special high-color-fastness process to lock in rich hues. They stay vibrant after washing, keeping the product stylish and durable for you and your pet.

【Perfect for Gifting】Suitable for all seasons, our furniture covers work not just as a sofa protector, but also as a windowsill cushion, bedside mat, or rug. It’s the ideal gift for pet owners and their furry companions, adding a sweet, warm touch to holidays or daily life.
